description:
About the Team 

 Here at BTI360, we’ve built a culture that’s passionate about developing software engineers. Software doesn't build itself. People do.  In fact, teams of people do.  That's why our primary focus is on developing better craftsmen, better teammates, and better technical leaders.  By putting people first, we're not just giving our teammates more opportunities to grow, we're also raising the bar of the software we ship. BTI360 previously has been voted 10 years in a row as a TOP Place to Work by the Washington Business Journal.  

 Are you an engineer interested in expanding the use of open-source intelligence (OSINT) data for end users and data scientists across the Intelligence Community? 

 We’re hiring a Data Platform Engineer to help expand our AWS- and Kubernetes-based data lake into a community-wide data hub. Our goal is to modernize the unclassified OSINT data layer by developing new access patterns and services that support AI/ML enrichment, ETL pipelines, and data discovery and dissemination. 

 If you are excited about building next-generation, scalable data architecture and applying your knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. 

 What You’ll Do in This Role 

 
 Build backend services using Java and the Spring ecosystem 

 Develop cloud-native solutions using AWS 

 Contribute to full-stack development using React and Next.js 

 Support event-driven architectures and distributed systems 

 Work across multiple projects within the data platform and data pipeline unit 

 Follow established Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes patterns using technologies such as Terraform and Terragrunt 

 Collaborate with DevOps teams on infrastructure-related initiatives 

 Help modernize and expand data access, metadata services, and platform capabilities 

 
 Minimum Qualifications 

 
 Active Secret clearance or higher, with the willingness and ability to upgrade to a TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or equivalent professional experience 

 Experience developing applications using Java and the Spring Framework 

 Experience developing solutions in AWS cloud environments 

 Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation 

 Experience with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Amazon SNS/SQS, EventBridge, Kinesis, or JMS 

 Experience designing, developing, and supporting modern data platforms, data lakes, and data pipelines using technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Snowflake, or comparable tools 

 Primary residence within a two-hour commuting distance of our Herndon office 

 Ability to work effectively as both a collaborative team member and a self-starter in a dynamic environment 

 
 Desired Qualifications 

 
 Active TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph 

 Experience optimizing platform performance and storage for client access patterns, supporting distributed data architectures, and implementing data lifecycle capabilities, including CRUD operations and record versioning 

 Experience with testing frameworks and tools such as JUnit, AssertJ, Mockito, or Spring Runner 

 Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Bash 

 Experience working in Linux environments 

 Experience using Git for source control 

 Deep, hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, DynamoDB, EKS, DocumentDB, Lambda, Timestream, CloudWatch, EC2, or ECS 

 Experience developing and deploying containerized applications 

 Experience with Kubernetes 

 Experience with React or Next.js 

 Ability to identify and interpret external data specifications and common data representations 

 Experience building monitoring and alerting capabilities for data pipelines using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk 

 Experience contributing to open-source projects or communities 

 
 The base salary pay range for this role is $125,900 - $247,900. This range reflects base compensation only and does not include benefits, bonuses, or additional pay incentives associated with the opportunity. 
 BTI360 benefits for full-time teammates 

 
 Fully paid healthcare premiums 

 Competitive salaries and performance bonuses 

 Career development and in-house training   

 Tuition Reimbursement 

 Up to 5 weeks PTO plus 2 weeks of federal holidays   

 401K dollar for dollar matching up to 6% annually - v ested immediately on day 1     

 Giving Back: Serving communities locally and across the globe 

 Social Events (happy hours, golf tournament, BTI360 Family Festival and more) 

 
 Commitment to Fairness and Inclusion 

 At BTI360, we believe that unlocking the potential of others is not just a mission—it's the heart of our culture. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual can grow each day, lead with humility, and do the right thing. Our core values guide us in developing software that makes a difference, primarily serving national security customers in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. 

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. We celebrate fairness and are dedicated to creating an environment of mutual respect and inclusion where everyone can bring their true selves to work. 

 Join us in a workplace where your contributions are valued, your growth is encouraged, and your potential is unlocked. Together, we develop great software fast and deliver exceptional solutions for our customers.
